faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Learn about our role, fees, and the loan application process.

items.question: Do you charge any upfront fees or commission from borrowers?
items.answer: No. We do not charge borrowers upfront or unauthorized advisory fees. Arohya Capital works as an empanelled Direct Selling Agent (DSA). Our partner bank or NBFC pays us for facilitation after a successful sanction and disbursal, according to its agreement.

items.question: Which banks and financial institutions do you partner with?
items.answer: We facilitate applications through our empanelled bank and NBFC partners. Available lenders and loan programs depend on your requirements, eligibility, location, and the lender's current policy.

items.question: How long does the loan approval process take in Tumkur?
items.answer: The lender reviews each application and sets its own timeline. Processing time depends on the loan type, completeness of your documents, verification, and the lender's approval process.

items.question: What if my CIBIL score is lower than average or has an old issue?
items.answer: A lower or limited credit history does not guarantee approval or rejection. We can help explain lender requirements and discuss suitable options; each lender makes its own decision after reviewing your application.

items.question: What land or property documents are required for a home loan in Tumkur?
items.answer: Requirements vary by lender and property. They commonly include sale deed or title documents, a recent encumbrance certificate, approved plan, tax receipts, and identity and income documents. Your selected lender will confirm the exact checklist.
